equations.title: Balance contact differs from gravity
equations.equation: N = mg − Fm, only while N ≥ 0
equations.plain: An upward magnetic force can reduce the balance contact force without changing gravity.
equations.convention: Static supported contact; external magnet reaction carried outside the balance.
equations.units: N and Fm newtons; m kilograms; g m/s².
cautions: The contact model does not apply after separation.
